Nestled in Georgia’s Blue Ridge Mountains, Port Royale is Lake Lanier’s premier marina destination, offering everything from daily pontoon and ski boat rentals to slips for harboring your boat. Plus, your slip membership will get you access to exclusive events, member’s parties, and top of the line amenities
